source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-10

procedures.title: Headlamp door replacement
steps: Remove the decorative radiator grille and its screws.
Take off the headlamp bezel and tape over the door opening to protect the paint.
Remove the inner and outer headlamps, unhooking their springs with a hooked wire or small locking pliers.
Remove the front screw and bushing joining the headlamp housing to the support assembly link.
Remove the "J" bar that runs down from the side of the housing.
Through the grille opening, remove the 3 cap screws holding the bearing and housing assemblies to the support assembly.
Lift the door assembly forward and out.
Move the remaining parts to the new door and install in reverse order.

procedures.title: Headlamp door vacuum actuator replacement
steps: Remove the decorative radiator grille and screws.
Open the headlamps part way and take off the long spring on each side of the pivot link pin.
Disconnect the 2 vacuum hoses from the actuator.
Pull the cotter pin and slide out the pivot pin to free the actuator rod.
Remove the 4 nuts from the actuator studs and slide the actuator down and out through the grille opening.
